root_cause: The previous repair wrote the Campaign103 loader into the callable returned by contextlib.contextmanager. That callable resolves wrapper globals from contextlib.py, while the generator body that patches base.load_factor_panel resolves _load_compact_factor_panel from _temporary_compact_factor_loader.__wrapped__.__globals__. The generator therefore still installed the inherited Campaign089 loader.
allowed_repair: Bind the already-tested Campaign103 loader into the context manager generator's exact __wrapped__.__globals__, assert both the wrapper and generator paths separately, and add a regression test that enters the context and proves base.load_factor_panel is the Campaign103 loader. Preserve the two-entry ledger, all factor semantics, folds, execution policy, costs, and gates.
